thread:
Jess: FYI tenant-x support ticket — p95 looks fine but p99 jumped to ~2.1s for text.generate this morning. customer reporting intermittent timeouts. dashboard shows no corresponding error spike :confused:
Ali: can you paste the panel/model + time range? which metric are we using for p99? rollup-derived or raw histogram?
Jess: panel uses `service.latency.p99` (rollup) in the 5m window, dashboard timezone UTC. range 03:00-04:00 UTC. raw histogram from the ingest panel looks like an increase in the >1s bucket but counts are low.
Mike: suspicious — we've seen low-count tail amplification when rollup window alignment mismatches histogram bucketization. did anything change in the proxy/retry config?
Jess: Support mentions a deploy of proxy v2.4.1 around 02:45 that adjusted retry backoff. cc @Ali @Sara
Ali: ObservabilityBot: show last deploys for proxy service
ObservabilityBot: deploys for proxy-service: v2.4.0 @ 2026-03-17T02:10Z, v2.4.1 @ 2026-03-17T02:46Z (config: increased max_retries from 2 -> 4, backoff_multiplier 1.5)
Sara: that could cause retried requests with large add-on latency to show up as separate samples, inflating p99 if sampling weights are per-original-request rather than per-observed-event :thinking:
Mike: also check KV cache eviction logs — if retries hit cold KV, tail latency jumps. any correlating cache miss spikes?
Ali: querying cache miss rate now — here's a quick query I ran:
```
max_over_time((kv.cache.miss_rate{shard=~"*"})[10m]) by (shard)
```
result: spike on shard-7 between 02:48-02:52

Jess: Support provided repro steps: send 500 concurrent requests to /v1/text.generate with long prompt ~1k tokens, header X-Tenant: tenant-x, run for 10m. they saw p99 ~2s after deploy and then dropped when we toggled retries off.
Mike: ok that's strong signal. So root cause hypothesis: retry config increased duplicate events and some retries hit cold KV/cache or slow downstream, causing a low-count but high-latency tail. Rollup-based p99 amplified because rollups sampled differently than raw histogram.
Sara: two short mitigations: 1) revert proxy retry config immediately (rollback v2.4.1) 2) change dashboard panel to use raw histogram-based p99 query for now (less sensitive to duplicate sample semantics).
Ali: longer term: instrument retries with `retry_id` and ensure metric ingest dedups or tags samples as `is_retry=true`, and adjust sampling weight semantics to be per-original-request.
Jess: I've opened support ticket update and told customer we're investigating and will roll back config if needed. I'll trigger rollback if you confirm.
Mike: I'll prepare rollback patch — ETA 10m. Also add temporary alert to page on p99 > 1.5s for text.generate across any tenant (5m window) so SRE sees recurrence.
Sara: Dashboard change: update query to `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(service_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and pin to raw ingest dataset. I'll push that now.
ObservabilityBot: alert created: p99-text-generate-high (THRESH=1.5s, window=5m) -> paging SRE -> active
Ali: logging reproduction command for ENG: `for i in {1..500}; do curl -sS -H "X-Tenant: tenant-x" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate & done` — include payload.json with long prompt. Also capture `--write-out '%{time_total}\n'` to get timings.
Jess: thanks team. verdict for customer: rollback proxy retries, change dashboard to raw histogram, add alert, and longer-term metric tagging + sampling semantics fix. I'll update support. :thumbsup:
Mike: rolling back now. Will post status when complete. :rocket:
Jess: (after rollback) rollback completed at 03:12 UTC — customer reports p99 back to normal within a few minutes. closing loop and scheduling a postmortem to track metric dedup/tagging work.
Ali: assign postmortem to eng-platform and eng-sre, link to ticket #SUP-7843.
Sara: adding a short playbook note under runbooks/observability about retry-induced-tail and preferred histogram queries.
Jess: thanks all.
